title: Abigiya and the Little Star
style_block: soft hand-painted storybook illustration, warm gentle light, pastel colours, painterly texture
character: Abigiya, a young Ethiopian girl about 8 years old with dark hair in two neat braids wearing a warm yellow-and-teal dress; and her older Ethiopian grandmother with grey hair wrapped in a traditional white cotton netela shawl

characters.abigiya: Abigiya, an 8-year-old Ethiopian girl with dark hair in two neat braids wearing a warm yellow-and-teal dress
characters.grandmother: an older Ethiopian grandmother with grey hair and a warm expression wearing a traditional white cotton netela shawl

voice.style: editorial note only (not sent in prompt): calm, warm Ethiopian Amharic bedtime storyteller

music.caption: gentle warm Ethiopian Tizita pentatonic krar and soft ambient pad lullaby, peaceful bedtime story underscore, slow tempo, instrumental, no vocals, soft dynamics leaving space for voice narration

shots.narration: በድሮ ዘመን፣ አቢጊያ የተባለች ትንሽ ልጅ በኢትዮጵያ ውብ መንደር ትኖር ነበር።
shots.subtitle: Once upon a time, a little girl named Abigiya lived in a beautiful village in Ethiopia.
shots.picture: Wide establishing view of a peaceful Ethiopian highland village at dusk, small round stone-and-thatch houses, glowing warm windows, green hills under a twilight sky, no people in foreground.
shots.reason: Establishes the time, place, and warm storybook mood in an Ethiopian highland village before introducing the protagonist.

shots.narration: በየምሽቱ በመስኮት አጠገብ ተቀምጣ የጨለማውን ሰማይ ከዋክብት ትመለከት ነበር።
shots.subtitle: Every night, she sat by the window and watched the stars in the dark sky.
shots.picture: Abigiya sits by her wooden bedroom window at night, resting her chin on her hands and looking up at the starry night sky.
shots.reason: Introduces Abigiya in her quiet bedroom and establishes her nightly habit of wonder and stargazing.

shots.narration: አንድ ምሽት፣ ከሁሉም ይበልጥ ደምቃ የምትታይ አንዲት ትንሽ ኮከብ አየች።
shots.subtitle: One night, she saw a small star shining brighter than all the others.
shots.picture: Wide night sky over dark Ethiopian hills where one small golden star shines much brighter than all the surrounding stars, no people in frame.
shots.reason: Introduces the central visual motif of the single small bright star in the night sky.

shots.narration: ፈገግ ብላም በዝግታ፣ «እኔም ልክ እንዳንቺ ማብራት በቻልኩ» አለች።
shots.subtitle: She smiled and softly said, "I wish I could shine like you."
shots.picture: Abigiya by the window smiling softly up toward the starlight reflected on her face.
shots.reason: Captures Abigiya's quiet wish to shine and bring light like the star.

shots.narration: አጠገቧ የነበረችው አያቷ ሰምታት፣ «የኔ ውድ፣ ለምን ኮከብ መሆን ፈለግሽ?» ስትል ጠየቀቻት።
shots.subtitle: Her grandmother, sitting nearby, heard her and asked gently, "My dear, why did you want to be a star?"
shots.picture: Her grandmother sits nearby in the warm room, looking toward Abigiya with a gentle, loving question.
shots.reason: Brings in the grandmother's presence and opens the dialogue that drives the lesson.

shots.narration: አቢጊያም፣ «ከዋክብት ጨለማን ያበራሉ። ዓለምን የተሻለች ማድረግ እፈልጋለሁ» አለች።
shots.subtitle: Abigiya replied, "Stars bring light to the darkness. I want to make the world a better place."
shots.picture: Abigiya turns with hands clasped over her heart and earnest, determined eyes as she answers.
shots.reason: Reveals Abigiya's motivation: stars bring light to darkness, and she wants to make the world better.

shots.subtitle: Her grandmother smiled and took her hand.
shots.picture: Close view of the grandmother smiling warmly and gently holding Abigiya's small hands.
shots.reason: Creates an intimate emotional pause that grounds the bond between grandmother and granddaughter before the main lesson.

shots.narration: «አቢጊያ፣ ብርሃን ለማምጣት ኮከብ መሆን አያስፈልግሽም። ሰው ስትረጂ፣ ደግነት ስታካፍሊ ወይም ብቸኛ ለሆነ ተስፋ ስትሰጪ ልክ እንደዚያች ኮከብ ታበሪያለሽ» አሏት።
shots.subtitle: "Abigiya, you don't need to be a star to bring light. Every time you help someone, share kindness, or give hope to someone who is lonely, you shine just like that star."
shots.picture: The grandmother speaks tenderly to Abigiya beside a glowing lantern while pointing gently toward the warm village outside.
shots.reason: Delivers the heart of the story: helping others, sharing kindness, and giving hope are how a person shines.

shots.subtitle: Abigiya looked up at the sky again.
shots.picture: Abigiya looks back up through the window toward the starry night sky with a calm, thoughtful expression.
shots.reason: Provides a quiet beat of reflection as Abigiya connects her grandmother's words to the star above.

shots.narration: ትንሽ ብርሃን እንኳን ለውጥ እንደሚያመጣ ተረዳች።
shots.subtitle: She understood that even a small light can make a difference.
shots.picture: Abigiya holds a small glowing lantern in both hands, her face lit with warm understanding.
shots.reason: Marks the internal turning point where she understands that even a small light makes a difference.

shots.narration: ከዚያ ምሽት ጀምሮ በሰዎች ሕይወት ትንሽ ብርሃን ለማምጣት ጣረች።
shots.subtitle: From that night on, she tried to bring a little light into people's lives.
shots.picture: Abigiya in the village courtyard at dusk sharing a warm lantern light and a cup of water with a smiling village child.
shots.reason: Shows her changed actions in the community as she brings light and kindness to others.

shots.subtitle: Her grandmother saw this and named her "Kokobe."
shots.picture: The grandmother embracing Abigiya outside under the starry Ethiopian night sky with warm lantern light around them.
shots.reason: Delivers the emotional payoff as her grandmother names her 'Kokobe' (My Star), leading into the AI disclosure end card.
